narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText: Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
